assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Produce ONE wide 3-column by 2-row illustration atlas for a primary grade one tool observation activity. Six equal rectangular tiles, perfectly straight grid seams, equal off-white gutters at exactly the thirds and half. Crop-friendly wide margins inside all tiles. Every illustration is diagrammatically precise with one subject and no props besides the identical pale wood practice table or plate. Artwork style fine paper grain, matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouettes, calm warm cream and deep pine, apricot and persimmon accents. No people, labels, words, numerals, letterforms, arrows, decorations, shadows obscuring structure, watermark, perspective tricks, or borders. Each column shows EXACTLY the same object in the same orientation, setup, and physical condition, changing camera from perfectly overhead (top row) to genuinely low eye-level side profile (bottom row). Left column: one flat translucent amber rectangular geometry drawing stencil ruler, long axis left-to-right, with one conspicuous open circular hole on left and one open triangular hole on right. Overhead shows the open holes clearly. Side profile shows the same very thin straight amber edge touching the flat table, with the holes hidden by the edge. Middle column: one small rounded deep-pine plastic toy tweezer tong with two visible apricot gripping pads, joined at left, tips slightly apart toward right, placed on an ivory practice board; tips raised very slightly above the board by its bent body, no hands or extra objects. Overhead shows the two pads pointing right and the gap between them. Side profile shows the same outline length, same green body and same apricot pads, with the nearer pad a little above the flat board; the farther pad may be visually behind it. Right column: the same two objects in both images, one orange-handled manual screwdriver lying horizontally on a cream workbench with its shaft pointing right, and a large demonstration screw fitted vertically into a small pale teal practice plate to the right of the screwdriver, clearly separate and not touching. Overhead shows a conspicuous accurate recessed cross groove on top of the single screw and the nearby orange handle and silver shaft. Low side profile shows the horizontal orange handle and silver shaft and the single fitted screw head above the plate, with the head groove obscured at eye-level. Nothing spills between tiles. Large simple isolated silhouettes readable at 85 pixels.
